concepts.description: The @atlas block itself: @kind/@partOf/@uses/@constructs semantics, @uses none/@uses? curation states, @atlas pin, DEFAULT_KINDS (kind is a role, not a layer), parseAtlasBlock/locateAtlasBlock(source, style)

Which comment syntax a block is written in: COMMENT_TABLE/COMMENT_STYLES, styleFor/entryFor/styleNameFor, `comments` overrides, placement preambles and per-language rules (README table test-held equal to COMMENT_TABLE)

Writing blocks from path rules: config `stamp` rules composing with $1 captures, stampFor, `atlas stamp [targets] --write/--overwrite` (additive, never @uses, skips pin), runStamp/resolveTargets, renderBlock/applyStamp
Installing and running atlas: bun add -d @inixiative/atlas or bunx @inixiative/atlas, Bun-only runtime (imports .atlas/*.ts), untrusted-repo caution
The atlas bin and runCli dispatcher: command list, common flags --root/--json, `atlas: <msg>` exit-1 error convention

The consumer's .atlas/ folder: defineConfig/partOfFor (@inixiative/atlas/config), kinds.ts, concepts.ts ConceptRegistry (classes, constituent and reference fields, references resolvers), loadConfig validation, conceptClass/invert, matchGlob
`atlas init`: detectLanguages and a starter .atlas/ written from examples/atlas-config, refusing an existing one
Which files atlas considers and how it reads them: include/ignore, git ls-files, ALWAYS_IGNORE, path-tagged files, text encodings; analyze, walkFiles
`atlas check [targets]`: presence, vocab, reference and thesaurus problems, --warn-only, scoped targets skip registry-wide checks; existence not correctness; runCheck
`atlas coverage`: unannotated files, @uses buckets (uncurated/curated-empty/proposed/curated), --min/--ratchet gates, .atlas/coverage-baseline.json and --update-baseline
Wiring atlas into CI: warn-only to enforcing rollout, the published workflows and pre-commit hook, MAP.md freshness gate, package.json scripts, no separate atlas-ci package
`atlas graph` reverse indexes (concept to files, @uses consumers, file to concepts, doc to concepts) and `atlas query` (axis flags ANDed, json-rules predicate); queryFiles, flagsToRule
Generated artifacts: byte-stable MAP.md via `atlas generate`, COVERAGE.md (Mermaid) and atlas.html (Cytoscape) via `atlas report` and their renderers
Claude Code PostToolUse hooks `atlas hook read|grep`, `atlas setup` merging into .claude/settings.json, cachedGraph, renderNeighbourhood/renderConceptMatches, findAtlasRoot
The optional .atlas/thesaurus.ts: per-concept phrases and doc, how grep patterns match phrases, validation and upkeep
The system-prompt / CLAUDE.md line telling agents to find code by concept via MAP.md and graph --json instead of grep
